summary: KIZILKAN PLAYER FAZ 1 tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (health, M3U parse-url/content, invalid M3U, invalid Xtream login, EPG fetch/now-next/channel). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport 390x844: onboarding renders Turkish branding, 'Oynatma Listesi Ekle' navigates to /add-playlist, 'Demo listeyi kullan' fills iptv-org TR URL, submit parses 207 channels and navigates to Live TV tab. Category chips render horizontally (22 chips) and filter correctly (News -> 27 channels). Search 'TRT' returns 42 rows. Favorite toggle via [data-testid=fav-toggle-<id>] works and channel appears in Favoriler tab with red heart. All 4 theme cards present; selecting 'Türk Bayrağı' switches brand color to rgb(227,10,23). Vu IPTV theme also applies. Playlist mgmt shows select/delete controls per playlist and 'Yeni liste ekle' link. EPG fetch via UI succeeded with working URL (14434 programs stored). Tapping channel row navigates to /player?id=... route; player shows graceful Turkish error 'Oynatma hatası. Yayın ulaşılamaz olabilir.' with 'Tekrar Dene' button (expected in headless web due to expo-video limitations). No React Native red screen. All UI text confirmed Turkish. One backend finding: EPG URL suggested in Settings hint (https://iptv-org.github.io/epg/guides/tr.xml) returns 404 as of Jan 2026 — needs update to a working source.

minor.issue: Default EPG URL suggested in Settings hint text (https://iptv-org.github.io/epg/guides/tr.xml) is 404. Works only if user supplies a valid XMLTV URL. Backend returns proper 400 with Turkish error, but UX is misleading.

issues: Suggested example URL https://iptv-org.github.io/epg/guides/tr.xml is dead (HTTP 404). Recommend replacing with a working default such as https://epgshare01.online/epgshare01/epg_ripper_TR1.xml.gz or https://www.open-epg.com/files/turkey1.xml.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from react-native-web or an @expo/vector-icons wrapper. Not blocking but should be tracked.

action_items: Update Settings EPG hint (app/(tabs)/settings.tsx around line 132) to reference a working XMLTV URL, e.g. https://epgshare01.online/epgshare01/epg_ripper_TR1.xml.gz.
Optional: investigate pointerEvents deprecation warning source in RN web build.
Confirm intended behavior: on Favoriler tab with 0 favorites, empty state 'Henüz favori kanalınız yok' shows correctly — verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 400-line file; acceptable size but consider splitting M3U / Xtream / EPG into modules if it grows further.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') — deprecated in newer FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers when convenient (non-blocking).

PlaylistContext persists entire channel arrays to AsyncStorage on every mutation — fine for a few thousand rows but may become expensive for very large Xtream lists; consider chunking or storing channels separately from playlist metadata in FAZ 2.
seed_data_creation: EPG programs collection populated with playlist_id='TEST_kizilkan_pl_1' by pytest and with the frontend-created playlist by UI test. Safe to leave; not touching production data.

rca_of_issue: Dead EPG URL: The URL https://iptv-org.github.io/epg/guides/tr.xml (used both in the review request and the app's Settings hint) returns 404 in Jan 2026. iptv-org restructured their EPG guides. Reproduction: curl -I https://iptv-org.github.io/epg/guides/tr.xml -> 404. Mitigation applied in tests: switched to https://epgshare01.online/epgshare01/epg_ripper_TR1.xml.gz which returns valid gzipped XMLTV parsed successfully (14434 programs). Backend gzip decompression path via _fetch_bytes works correctly.
